labels: Arms long, bar against your thighs
Pull up, leading with the elbows

text.setup: Stand tall holding the bar against your thighs, hands about shoulder-width or a little wider.
cues: Lift your elbows up and out to the sides; the bar follows close to your body.
Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly back to your thighs.
mistakes: Hands so close together that the shoulders pinch at the top.
Swinging the bar up with your hips.

variants.barbell: A wider grip is easier on the shoulders than a close one.
variants.dumbbells: Bells let each hand find a comfortable path.
variants.cable: A straight bar or rope on a low pulley keeps tension at the bottom.
variants.smith: The fixed track keeps the bar close to you.
variants.resistance_band: Stand on the band; it gets harder the higher you pull.
